_comment: Which AI engines mos-geo-query-fan-out asks, and the DataForSEO endpoints it uses. Verified live 2026-09-25 (see references/evidence.md). DataForSEO is the only provider: the LLM Scraper (ChatGPT app) does not return fan_out_queries, so this pack only uses LLM Responses (models) and LLM Mentions (prompt discovery). gpt-5.6-luna is the default fan-out model: $0.024/call with 6 fan-outs matching terra's exact-string and site: queries on the one prompt tested live. gpt-5.6-terra ($0.044-0.062/call) is selectable per run with `run --model gpt-5.6-terra`. Model names go stale: `fanout.py preflight` checks them against DataForSEO's live model list. Set enabled=false to skip an engine.

engines.label: ChatGPT
engines._note: Default fan-out model. Override per run with `run --model gpt-5.6-terra` (pricier, same fan-out shape) or another live model name.

engines.label: Perplexity
engines._note: Sonar always searches; web_search is not sent for it.

generator_model._comment: Cheap closed-book model used by `prompts` to draft buyer prompts from a page's title/headings. Not used for fan-out itself.

cost_estimate._comment: Rough $/call from references/evidence.md, used only for the preflight cost estimate and the spend cap math. Actual cost is read from DataForSEO's own `cost` field on every call and is always what governs the spend cap during `run`.
